user.title: Talento smart BLE
user.description: Read channel 1 status and control FIX ON/OFF. FIX remains active until you restore AUTO. Enter the C15 Bluetooth MAC address. Use an ESPHome Bluetooth Proxy with active connections or a local Bluetooth adapter. Override and PIN authentication are not supported yet.

error.invalid_address: Enter a MAC address such as AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF.
